research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen roster and government biography compared with first-person maiden speech and party biography. Searched both engines for Carol Brown portfolio services, DPAC, Bryan Green, full-time employment and historical annual reports. Same-name American rowing and other people were excluded.

Classification gap: 1998-2002 DPAC role needs contemporaneous position description, staff listing or appointment record. Current DPAC annual-report index does not reach that tenure. Search results did not locate a relevant historical staff record; no outreach sent.

No hours evidence found. Current advertisements for staff in Senator Brown office describe other workers, not her own pre-parliamentary employment. Senior manager title and uninterrupted year ranges do not prove full-time work.

Chronology before 1984 is unresolved, including any earlier jobs or study. The first speech describes party membership at 20 but does not establish that employment began on the membership date. No private-employment absence or zero may be inferred.

Follow-up: locate DPAC 1998-2002 personnel/annual reports; determine political versus ordinary service status, exact dates, hours and leave including 2000 party appointment overlap. Seek early career and named 2002-04 minister/employing entity. All year-only periods retained without invented January boundaries.
Source access: official first-speech PDF restricted; indexed original and readable reproduction documented separately. This individual access gap did not stop national research.

Follow-up2026-10-02: targeted portfolio-services, DPAC1998–2002, minister-office and pre-Senate searches returned repeat biographies and namesakes, no personal classification/hours evidence. Contemporary proclamation identifies Bryan Green holding primary-industries portfolio in February2003, but does not independently establish Brown’s contract. No material employment gap resolved; excluded from enrichment count.

The previously identified2001–02DPAC report URL returned HTTP404 on direct retrieval; no archived copy or ministerial-staff schedule was exposed. Searches for the2000acting party-secretary overlap and the2002–04office likewise produced no contract or boundary evidence. No dates, category or full-time status changed; advance while retaining these gaps.
